about: Every finding task game:parse's GUI suite finds in the install's GUI files, classified: a defect of the game's own files (game-defect) or a fault of pychivalry's GUI parser to fix (pychivalry-fault). Matched by layer (game, jomini or clausewitz), file, finding id and line; a finding without an entry, or an entry without a finding, fails the suite (tools/src/gui-suite.ts). Every GUI finding is information (docs/checks.md, The GUI syntax findings); each is classified all the same, so that a GUI file parses when it gives none. Game 1.21.0.3.

classifications.reason: 'margin { 50 0 }' in a debug test window, written without its '='. The base game's GUI files write 'margin = { ... }' 3,364 times and 'margin { ... }' only here; no evidence shows the GUI reader reads it as 'margin = { 50 0 }'.
'align right|top' written without its '=' among a text_single's properties. The base game's GUI files write 'align = ...' 3,034 times and a key followed by its value with no '=' only here.
'size { 5 0 }' in a spacer, written without its '='. The base game's GUI files write 'size = { ... }' 11,677 times and 'size { ... }' twice, here and in gui/window_legends.gui.
'size { ... }' written without its '='. The base game's GUI files write 'size = { ... }' 11,677 times and 'size { ... }' twice, here and in gui/window_dynasty_house.gui.

'tooltipwidget = struggle_tooltip;': the ';' makes the value the word 'struggle_tooltip;', which nothing defines. The base game writes 'tooltipwidget = struggle_tooltip' twice elsewhere (gui/hud.gui:5645) and defines the template struggle_tooltip in gui/shared/cooltip.gui; no other value of the base game's GUI files ends with ';' but 'expanding;' in gui/window_dlc_info.gui.
'layoutpolicy_horizontal = expanding;': the ';' makes the value the word 'expanding;'. The base game's GUI files write 'layoutpolicy_horizontal = expanding' 9,795 times and 'expanding;' only here.

A ';' after a quoted data binding, apart from it: read as a value of its own among the widget's properties.
